name: gamify-ai
description: Control VS Code and Copilot Chat with a gamepad. Modular architecture for extensible gamepad integration.

commands.title: Show Gamepad Debug Info
commands.description: Outputs current gamepad state and active mappings to the output channel.

commands.title: Show Gamepad Debug Window
commands.description: Opens an SDL window visualizing gamepad state in real-time.

commands.title: Show Gamify AI - Avatar
commands.description: Shows the Gamify AI avatar panel with animated single-frame portrait.

gamifyAI.enabled.description: Enable gamepad input for Gamify AI

gamifyAI.pollingIntervalMs.description: Gamepad polling interval in milliseconds (lower = more responsive, higher CPU usage)

gamifyAI.debounceMs.description: Minimum time between repeated actions in milliseconds (prevents rapid duplicates)

gamifyAI.tts.backend.description: TTS backend: 'stub' (simulated), 'pocket' (Python server), or 'auto' (pick best available)

gamifyAI.tts.pocket.port.description: Port for the Pocket TTS Python server

gamifyAI.tts.pocket.modelPath.description: Optional path to a custom Pocket TTS model

gamifyAI.tts.pocket.voice.description: Voice identifier for Pocket TTS (HuggingFace URL, local file, or 'default')
